claims.claim: Deep Review is launching publicly after deployments across more than 16,000 submissions at STOC, ICML, NeurIPS, and ICLR.
claims.episode_span: private pre-submission feedback on more than 16,000 manuscripts at STOC 2026, ICML 2026, NeurIPS 2026, and ICLR 2027
claims.source_title: Analyzing technical documents with Deep Review
claims.supporting_quote: Following successful deployments across 16,000+ submissions at STOC, ICML, NeurIPS, and ICLR, Deep Review is launching publicly.

claims.claim: Every Deep Review user receives two complimentary document reviews per week, and uploads are stored for one year and are not used to train Google models.
claims.episode_span: every user gets two complimentary document reviews a week
claims.source_title: Analyzing technical documents with Deep Review
claims.supporting_quote: Every user receives two complimentary document reviews per week.

claims.claim: Three major AI conferences received over 74,000 submissions this year, up from about 45,000 in 2025, 32,000 in 2024, and 23,000 in 2023.
claims.episode_span: this year’s submissions to ICLR, NeurIPS, and ICML topped 74,000, up from about 45,000 in 2025
claims.source_title: Analyzing technical documents with Deep Review
claims.supporting_quote: This year, there were over 74,000 submissions to three major AI conferences ( ICLR , NeurIPS , and ICML ) up from approximately 45,000 in 2025, 32,000 in 2024, and 23,000 in 2023.

claims.claim: Apple told the Financial Times that iPhone Duo demand was nothing short of extraordinary, and new Apple orders no longer deliver in 2026.
claims.episode_span: demand has been “nothing short of extraordinary”
claims.source_title: Apple Calls iPhone Duo Demand 'Extraordinary' After Orders Slip to 2027
claims.supporting_quote: Demand for the iPhone Duo has been "nothing short of extraordinary," Apple said in a statement to the Financial Times .

claims.claim: iPhone Duo pricing starts at 1,999 dollars and reaches 3,199 dollars for 2TB, and by 5:30 a.m. Pacific delivery estimates reached January 25.
claims.episode_span: Pricing starts at 1,999 dollars and goes to 3,199 dollars for 2TB
claims.supporting_quote: Pricing on the ‌iPhone Duo‌ starts at $1,999 and goes up to $3,199 for 2TB of storage.

claims.claim: Brad Smith announced Copilot for Legal on October 16 with more than 20 specialized AI skills for commercial customers worldwide.
claims.episode_span: Brad Smith announced Copilot for Legal, with more than 20 specialized AI skills
claims.source_title: Microsoft Launches Legally Approved Version of Copilot with Over 20 AI Legal Capabilities
claims.supporting_quote: On October 16, Microsoft President and Vice Chairman Brad Smith announced the launch of Copilot for Legal, offering over 20 specialized AI skills for legal work to commercial customers worldwide.

claims.claim: Apple updated App Store guidelines 1.2 and 2.5.19 to cover AI deepfakes and features added after review, and extended its trafficking and child-exploitation ban to alternative distribution.
claims.episode_span: Updated guideline 1.2 names AI content-creation apps.
claims.source_title: New App Store Rules Target AI Deepfakes and Nudify Apps
claims.supporting_quote: The updated 1.2 rule names AI content creation apps and could be targeting apps like Grok, among others.

claims.claim: Jeff Williams said the consent prompt and indicator light on Amazon's Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse reach the wearer, not people being recorded.
claims.episode_span: the consent prompt and indicator light on Amazon’s Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse reach the wearer, not the people being recorded
claims.source_title: Amazon’s new Bee AI devices have a bystander problem, says former AWS security engineer
claims.supporting_quote: Jeff Williams, now chief information security officer at Sigma360, says the consent prompt and indicator light on Amazon's Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse reach the wearer, not the people being recorded.

claims.claim: The UK CMA proposed Strategic Market Status for Microsoft in business software, with comments due November 13 and a final decision by February 13, 2027.
claims.episode_span: Comments on the proposed decision are invited by November 13, and the authority will take a final decision by February 13, 2027.
claims.source_title: UK Watchdog Proposes Strategic Market Tag for Microsoft, Puts Excel and Copilot AI Under Competition Scrutiny
claims.supporting_quote: The regulator has invited comments on the proposed decision by Nov. 13 and will take a final decision by Feb. 13, 2027.

claims.claim: Apple's release says iPhone Duo availability begins on October 30, 2026, and preorders began at 5:00 a.m. PT on October 16, 2026.
claims.episode_span: iPhone Duo availability begins on October 30, 2026
claims.source_title: Apple announces iPhone Duo preorders: what it means for Apple stock
claims.supporting_quote: Apple’s release states that iPhone Duo availability begins on October 30, 2026, while selected accessories are also being introduced with the product.
